description: Defines the ThreadCpuUsage class for tracking per-thread CPU usage in Android, including methods for enabling/disabling tracking, sampling CPU time, and querying CPU frequency.

classes.name: ThreadCpuUsage
classes.description: A class for tracking CPU usage of the current thread, providing methods to enable/disable tracking, sample CPU time, and query CPU frequency.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether CPU usage tracking is currently enabled.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables CPU usage tracking for the current thread.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables CPU usage tracking for the current thread.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status for CPU tracking, returning previous status.

methods.name: sampleAndEnable
methods.description: Samples CPU usage and enables tracking if not already enabled.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Samples CPU usage without changing tracking status.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Returns elapsed wall clock time since last reset or enable.

methods.name: resetElapsed
methods.description: Resets the elapsed wall clock timer.

methods.name: getCpukHz
methods.description: Returns current CPU frequency in kHz for a given CPU.
